cell: P1.35 (rung L1.4), test T2 of reports/analyses/2026-11-18_analysis_definition-vs-experiments.md, T6 folded in; replaces the P1.31 design. No E-code claimed yet: the lead fills this field when it claims one.
status: Drafted 2026-11-18 by a subagent for definition-lead's review; filed once the lead commits it with an E-code. Not to be edited after any reading.
definition: decisions.md rows of 2026-11-18, unchanged: exact featurization fixed from M (units, no remainder needed; coverage condition: every weight in one variable); K* = the minimal circuit for B in F's featurized model under mean ablation; R = mean over K* of s_u, s_u comparing F's and M's mechanism of u on the parent settings that occur, by squared cosine (a pure output gain is kept, ask 51a); a variable F has and M lacks scores 0 (ask 51b). R, f, rho', the band and the pass rule below are this test's readings and rules, not clauses of the definition.

settings.piece_windows_source: E137's first_n (experiments/reuse_variable_test/pieces.py Config: the windows of D's read half its first wording's exact checks used); the full read half is 100,000 windows, about 25 times the cost of an exhaustive search for no reading the rules use.
settings.settings_source: alpha 0.9: the definition-vs-experiments audit's T2 and E208's tau; alphas and restricted_share: the audit's T6; orders, order_seed, chunk: E208's filed values (experiments/rho_saved_items/results/predictions.json); split_seed, slot_layer through g_fallback_ratio: P1.31's draft (experiments/known_answer_levels/results/predictions.json), sources there (E62, E206, E196); e195_layer, e195_C, e195_factors: E195/E208's filed values; graft settings: E206's (experiments/graft_sites/results/predictions.json), early_lowest left out because its E206 checks failed (no reading); pieces: E137's saved file; polish_cap: a time guard set here, logged when hit, enters no reading.

thresholds.thresholds_source: kl_floor, gate_tol: E208's filed values; e62_base, e62_tol: E62's filed a_heads rule; band_factor 3: the 3 s bar of E55's filed rules, as P1.31 drafted it; s_tol: a squared cosine of identical fp64 writes is 1 to rounding (E208's x2/x10 read 1 within it); identity_tol: R = 1 - f(1 - rho') is algebra; thin_floor 0.9: the bottom of the audit's bound on neuron-level R for every trained fine-tune (0.88 worst unit, 0.99 for K of 128 or more, E213), rounded down; piece_gate_tol: fp32 agreement between two code paths of one formula; l1_hours_cap: the plan's time stop; a_prime_copy_max: R0's stage-1 check 'M's copy after A' <= 0.05', as P1.31 drafted it (experiments/known_answer_levels/results/predictions.json).

readings.variables: per level, plan appendix section 1; a graft is its own variable at L1 (heads and neurons) and L2 (heads); inside its MLP layer, attention layer or block above that; E137 pieces are the rest-of-network remainder variable at every level, M's mechanism for it writing zero
readings.mean_ablation: a variable outside K writes its position-wise mean write over D, taken from F's unablated run
readings.K_star: smallest K with KL(F || F_K) <= (1 - alpha) KL(F || F_all_ablated), KL of the next-token distribution at the item's read positions, mean over D's windows; L4 and L3 exhaustive, L2 greedy (5 orders) plus polish, L1 greedy in chunks (order 0 by attribution, orders 1-4 seeded); ties: the lowest-KL minimal set reported, all listed
readings.s_u: 1 - mean over settings of (1 - cos^2(write_F(v), write_M(v))), settings = the variable's input residual at every position of D in M's run and in F's run (main); both writes zero counts 1, one zero counts 0; graft and piece variables 0; side reading: the read positions only
readings.C: variables any of whose weights differ from M's, plus graft and piece variables
readings.R_f_rho: R = mean s_u over K*; f = |K* & C| / |K*|; rho' = mean s_u over K* & C (null when empty); remainder share of K* = 0 on M-shaped items, 1/|K*| when a piece is in K*
readings.band: per level: band_factor x the largest, over the four P1.31 edits, of max(sd of R over the 5 orders (0 where exhaustive), |R(half 1) - R(half 2)| with K* searched per half, max - min of R over tied minimal K*)

expected.do_nothing: R = 1, f = 0, every s_u = 1 within s_tol, at every level
expected.positive_control: E201's graft at L1 and L2: in K*, s = 0, rho' = 0, R = 1 - 1/|K*| (2/3 if K* = {embedding, graft, unembedding})
expected.edits_by_hand: plan appendix section 3 (made-up cosines, stated): L1 reuse 0.973, new few 0.733, new thin 0.99; L2 reuse small 0.9988, reuse large 0.9988, new few 0.9951, new thin 0.990; L3 0.9985, 0.9797, 0.9935, 0.9867; L4 0.9980, 0.9846, 0.9935, 0.9867

R0 (stops).rule: Stage 0, alone: exit 1 unless (a) do-nothing at all four levels has every s_u within s_tol of 1, f = 0 and R = 1 within s_tol; (b) for every item and level met later, F_K with K = all variables matches F's native logits within gate_tol (max |diff| / max |logit|) and F with every variable ablated gives the mean logits within gate_tol; (c) copying.induction top-1 on M within e62_tol of e62_base; (d) x10's eight C neurons at L1 have s within s_tol of 1; (e) E201's graft at L2 is in K* with s = 0 and R = 1 - f exactly (identity_tol); (f) each E137 piece's one-line form matches E137's piece_edit logits within piece_gate_tol. Stage 1: P1.31's build checks (copy top-1 >= copy_bar_frac x M's; lookup top-1 >= lookup_bar; M's copy after A' <= 0.05; gamma_T <= gamma_t_max; each edit's KL(F || M) on D > kl_floor) stop on a miss. Any level's identity check R = 1 - f(1 - rho') off by more than identity_tol when f > 0 stops (code error). L1: the first search's projected total over l1_hours_cap stops the pod.
R0 (stops).blind_to: whether s_u means what the definition means: (a)-(f) check code paths, not the grade
R0 (stops).positive_control: (d) and (e) are the declarations' own controls: a gain must read 1, a graft 0
R0 (stops).noise_floor: fp64 grades: identical writes give cos^2 = 1 to about 1e-15; gate_tol from E208's measured hybrid gate

R1 (a level recovers the labels).rule: for level L at alpha 0.9 on all of D: recovers iff min(R reuse_small, R reuse_large) - max(R new_few, R new_thin) > band(L), strictly, AND f > 0 for both reuse edits at L. Four cells, each 'recovers' or 'does not'.
R1 (a level recovers the labels).absolute_or_relative: absolute difference of R values against a measured band
R1 (a level recovers the labels).blind_to: update size beyond the one matched pair (reuse_large against the larger new edit); any reuse not built as a re-triggered circuit; the trained pairs
R1 (a level recovers the labels).positive_control: E201's graft reads below reuse_small at L2 (P5): the grade can read a new part low
R1 (a level recovers the labels).noise_floor: the band itself, measured in stages 1-3 per level; proxy before the run: E208's largest order sd of rho, 1.3e-4 (experiments/rho_saved_items/results/summary.json, R3)

R2 (the cell's verdict).rule: 'pass' iff R1 reads 'recovers' at one or more levels; the levels are listed. Else 'fail'.

P1 (the neuron level misses the thin new.rule: at L1, alpha 0.9, all of D: R(new_thin) >= thin_floor AND R(new_thin) > R(new_few) + band(L1). Holds iff both. And R1 at L1 reads 'does not'.
P1 (the neuron level misses the thin new.blind_to: how the thin edit's per-neuron change size is set (least norm only)
P1 (the neuron level misses the thin new.positive_control: new_few at L1, the same new write in eight units, expected near 1 - 8/|K*|

P2 (the head-and-MLP-layer level recover.blind_to: a gain on a neuron group inside an MLP layer, which L2 grades as a changed layer (see P4)

P3 (the layer and block levels do not, t.rule: at L3 and at L4: R1 reads 'does not' AND R(reuse_large) <= max(R new_few, R new_thin) + band(L). Holds iff all four conditions.
P3 (the layer and block levels do not, t.blind_to: whether a different matched-size reuse edit (a gain spread over several heads) would read otherwise
P3 (the layer and block levels do not, t.positive_control: reuse_small at the same levels, expected above the new edits

P4 (gains: kept where the gain is a unit.rule: at L1: |R(x2) - 1| <= s_tol and |R(x10) - 1| <= s_tol, and rho' = 1 within s_tol where f > 0. At each of L2, L3, L4: R(x2) - R(x10) > band(L). Holds iff all eight conditions.
P4 (gains: kept where the gain is a unit.blind_to: gains of sign -1 (not built); whether the E195 windows' size (75) moves the means
P4 (gains: kept where the gain is a unit.positive_control: do-nothing on the same 75 windows, R = 1
P4 (gains: kept where the gain is a unit.noise_floor: s_tol at L1; band(L) at L2-L4 (bands are measured on the edits; the E195 items' own split-half R is reported beside them)

P5 (grafts read new).rule: for each of the five head grafts at L1 and at L2: the graft variable is in K* and rho' = 0 when it is the only changed variable in K*; and at L2, R(graft) < R(reuse_small) - band(L2). Holds iff all fifteen conditions.
P5 (grafts read new).blind_to: what the graft computes: any graft scores 0, so this checks K* and the declaration, not the grade
P5 (grafts read new).positive_control: it is the run's positive control

P6 (the moved copy: new at neurons, kept.rule: at L1: R(moved copy) < 1 - s_tol with at least one appended neuron in K*. At L2, L3, L4: |R(moved copy) - 1| <= s_tol. Holds iff all four.
P6 (the moved copy: new at neurons, kept.blind_to: nothing beyond the declared featurization: this is the stated property that R is not invariant to re-coordinatizing an old computation
P6 (the moved copy: new at neurons, kept.positive_control: x2 at L1 (same neurons, gain only) reads 1

P7 (T6: the passing level's sign is not.rule: for each level where R1 reads 'recovers': the sign of min(R reuse) - max(R new) is positive at alpha 0.8, at alpha 0.95, and on the restricted D (the half of D's windows with the largest KL(F || M), alpha 0.9). Holds iff positive in all three. Not read if no level recovers.
P7 (T6: the passing level's sign is not.blind_to: other D choices (other cue sets, other window lengths)
P7 (T6: the passing level's sign is not.noise_floor: none applied: a sign; the magnitudes are reported

rules.reported only: E195 rebuilt at every level; E206's neuron graft; E137's four pieces (expected: Always on R = 1, f = 0 at every level; Cue, XOR, Table 1 - 1/|K*| if in K*, else 1); the read-position side reading of every item; the remainder share of K*; |K*| and f for every item and level.

edge_cases_checked: plan appendix section 7: empty K* (cannot meet the bar when KL_all > 0; KL_all <= kl_floor stops the edits), one-variable K*, f = 0 (rho' null; pass needs f > 0 for reuse), zero denominators (E208's conventions; band 0 needs a strictly positive gap), tied minimal K* (range into the band; rules strict), do-nothing as a silent new edit (reads 1, cannot cause a false pass), all four equal (gap 0, no pass), parts leaving K* in P1, P4, P5, P6 (written to fail, not fall through), P7 unread when no level recovers, restricted D undefined for do-nothing.
